description: Aménagements cyclables Île de la Réunion is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Geovelo. This database contains all the cycling facilities on Reunion Island, digitized in OpenStreetMap and processed by Geovelo in order to restore them according to the national scheme of cycling facilities. The reference is made to the geographical codes of the municipalities of the 2022 vintage. Coverage: Geovelo. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling facilities Reunion Island" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Geovelo. Its keywords include amenagements-cyclables, reunion. The listing shows 6 download or service links in PARQUET. The listing shows 2026-08-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
